name: agentx
description: One local-first AgentX repository: shared capabilities, optional surfaces and replaceable harnesses

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix core && npm ci --prefix benchmark && npm ci --prefix rag && npm ci --prefix data && npm run setup:integrations
scripts.test:prepare: npm run test:prepare --prefix core && npm run test:prepare --prefix benchmark
scripts.test: npm test --prefix core && npm test --prefix benchmark && npm test --prefix rag -- --runInBand && npm test --prefix data -- --runInBand
scripts.test:nodb: npm run test:nodb --prefix core && npm run test:nodb --prefix benchmark
scripts.test:shared: node --test shared/benchmarkCategories.test.js shared/hostRegistry.test.js shared/embeddingModels.test.js shared/artifactRuntimeIdentity.test.js shared/outboundHttpExecutor.test.js shared/recoveryBundleContract.test.js shared/recoveryDrillReceiptContract.test.js shared/signalEvidence.test.js shared/testing/listenLoopback.test.js shared/testing/runJest.test.js skills/obsidian-open-formats/scripts/validate.test.js shared/agentxClaimAttestation.test.js scripts/runtime-lease.test.js scripts/ci-scope.test.js shared/envStatus.test.js shared/browserOriginGuard.test.js scripts/env-catalog.test.cjs
scripts.check:compose: docker compose --env-file config/agentx.env config --quiet && docker compose --env-file config/agentx.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.ollama.yml --profile ollama config --quiet && node scripts/check-compose-isolation.cjs
scripts.test:integrations: npm test --prefix integrations/openclaw/super-dad-memory && npm test --prefix integrations/openclaw/finance-ledger && npm test --prefix integrations/benchmark-harness-broker && node --test integrations/coding/test/with-agentx-claim.test.js && node scripts/test-native-tools.cjs
scripts.setup:integrations: npm ci --prefix integrations/openclaw/gmail-secretary --omit=peer && npm ci --prefix integrations/openclaw/dsh-coding-agent --omit=peer
